description: This file contains type definitions, utility functions, and imports related to channel status, traffic status, monitoring, and runtime management within a plugin SDK. It exports functions for building status summaries, running monitors, resolving runtimes, and handling status fields.

methods.name: buildPassiveChannelStatusSummary
methods.description: Builds a summary object for passive channel status, optionally extending with extra data.

methods.name: buildPassiveProbedChannelStatusSummary
methods.description: Builds a detailed passive channel status summary including probe information.

methods.name: buildTrafficStatusSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of traffic status with inbound and outbound timestamps.

methods.name: runStoppablePassiveMonitor
methods.description: Runs a passive monitor that can be stopped, managing its lifecycle with account management.

methods.name: resolveLoggerBackedRuntime
methods.description: Resolves or creates a runtime object backed by a logger.

methods.name: requireChannelOpenAllowFrom
methods.description: Enforces that a channel policy allows 'allowFrom' entries, throwing an error if not.

methods.name: readStatusIssueFields
methods.description: Extracts specified fields from a status issue object.

methods.name: coerceStatusIssueAccountId
methods.description: Converts a value to a string account ID if possible.

methods.name: createDeferred
methods.description: Creates a deferred promise with external resolve and reject functions.
